members.removedEmailFailed: {name} was removed, but the email telling them could not be sent.
members.removedRotationFailed: {name} was removed, but the household key could not be rotated: {reason}. Rotate it below when you are ready.

invite.emailFailed: Invitation created, but the email to {email} could not be sent. Ask them to sign in with that address.
invite.created: Invitation created. Ask them to sign in with {email}.
invite.atLimit: This household is limited to {max} members. Remove a member or revoke a pending invitation to invite someone else.
invite.noEmail: No email is sent. Tell them to sign in with that address; the invitation is waiting for them there for 7 days.

key.title: Household key
key.rotationDue: A member was removed but the household key has not been rotated since. Until it is, anything written now is readable with the key their device still holds.
key.explain: Rotating re-encrypts everything under a new key and gives every member the new key automatically. It happens on its own when you remove someone; you can also run it by hand. You will be shown a new recovery code — the old one stops working.
key.pdfFailures: Household key rotated, but {count} PDF(s) could not be re-encrypted and were left as they were.
